channel.title: Palm Coast Observer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Palm Coast Observer (observerlocalnews.com)

item.title: Second annual Masks for Miracles for hospitalized children set for March 21
item.description: 'There's this magic in the air, and people's hearts just open up for the cause,' Organizer Pam Capela said. Funds raised at the event will go to the nonprofit Live Like Cameron.

item.title: Palm Coast Vice Mayor Pontieri on campaign donations and vapes
item.description: Vice Mayor Theresa Carli Pontieri recently announced she would be returning campaign donations from five developers and that she would be co-authoring a bill on smoke shops and vapes.

item.title: Letter: Last-minute East Hampton shift raises concerns
item.description: 'The proposal ... represents a substantial departure from the previously litigated agreement and appears to be structured in a way that sets a precedent for increased density in future developments.'

item.title: Events calendar: Head to Princess Place Preserve for the Flagler County Native American Festival
item.description: What to do this week in Ormond Beach and Palm Coast.

item.title: Volusia County Council Chairman Brower calls for local control at State of the County
item.description: From water quality to economics, Chairman Jeff Brower said local officials are in the best position to make those decisions.

item.title: Burn ban in effect in Volusia County, Daytona under 'Red Flag Warning'
item.description: Under the burn ban, all outdoor burning is prohibited unless specifically authorized by the Florida Forest Service.

item.title: Flagler Beach commissioner's concerns with City Manager Martin fizzle without action
item.description: 'What are we doing? Is this just an agenda to complain,' Commissioner Eric Cooley said. 'We’re up here debating, without purpose.'

item.title: Ormond Beach DAR Chapter memorializes slice of history at Sanchez Park
item.description: The installation of a new historical marker last fall is part of a national effort to recognize patriots as the U.S. approaches its 250th anniversary.

item.title: Young landscaping business owner files to run for Ormond Beach mayor
item.description: Damien Curry, owner of Garden Boys Landscaping, filed to run for the open seat on Feb. 13.

item.title: Plantation Bay pool home is Ormond Beach's top sale at $695K
item.description: Built in 2017, the house is a 3/2 and has a pool and 2,608 square feet.
